2099-2364-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-2364-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Mana Vault, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mana Vault from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

813-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
813-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
813-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scholar of the Ages and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-1116-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-1116-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2393-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2393-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

719-4247-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-4247-4302.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1681-4140-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2292-2738-4871-6112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2411-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2411-3259-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Lathril, triggering Breath of Fury and Lathril.
Resolve the Lathril trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

862-2997-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-2997-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-4258-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch
1618-2440-4258-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-4258-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

206-1563-2457-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7330.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1734-4050-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Fiend Hunter and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-4659-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-4659-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7154.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

414-4419-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-4419-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

4316-5033-5078-5679.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
4316-5033-5078-5679.description:
Activate a land that enters the battlefield untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Kellan triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

3394-6249-6797--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3394-6249-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3322-5702-5954-6664.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3322-5702-5954-6664.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3322-5702-5954-6664.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

3487-4636-6188-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that is a 5/5 artifact creature with haste.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, its first ability, Aetherstorm Roc and Gonti's Aether Heart trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, causing you to rummage.
Resolve the remaining triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker. The token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1308-1753-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1322-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-2103-2239-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2103-2239-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

1368-1414-3327-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1368-1414-3327-5256.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Dargo's power.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Once you have milled your library, you may target other players using Altar of Dementia's ability.

2744-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2744-4613-5507.description:
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
When the Human enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat using the Human token instead.

1339-2425-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

943-1671-2203-2597-4235.notablePrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Simic Growth Chamber.
943-1671-2203-2597-4235.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding {G/U}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Simic Growth Chamber.
Repeat.

860-1462-3197.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a permanent to enter the battlefield under your control.
860-1462-3197.description:
Cause a permanent to enter the battlefield under your control.
Calix's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token that is also an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening.
Repeat from step 2.

224-1525-1644-2248.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
224-1525-1644-2248.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tatyova and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Resolve the Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

824-2445-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
824-2445-4289.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, and putting two +1/+1 counters on another target creature.
Repeat.

230-2034-2252-4871.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2034-2252-4871.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {C}{C}.
The Eldrazi Scion dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

29-3489.notablePrerequisites:
Master of Cruelties does not have summoning sickness.
You have a creature card in hand with power one or greater.
An opponent is unable to block Master of Cruelties.
29-3489.description:
Declare Master of Cruelties as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block it.
When Master of Cruelties isn't blocked, its ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate any creature card with power one or greater in your hand's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Master of Cruelties from the battlefield to your hand, putting the creature card onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Master of Cruelties trigger, causing the blocking opponent's life total to become one.
Deal combat damage with the attacking creature, causing the opponent's life total to become zero or less.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

565-1309-4598-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Salvager of Secrets.
The Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking the nontoken Salvager of Secrets.
The nontoken Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
